info.title: Invoice Platform - Processing & Reconciliation API (FastAPI)
info.description:
Bulk invoice upload, reconciliation against purchase orders, processing
history and reports. Built with **FastAPI + SQLAlchemy + Pydantic**.

Master data (vendors, purchase orders, invoices) is managed by the companion
**Django REST Framework** service; both services share one PostgreSQL
database whose schema is owned by the Django migrations.

post.summary: Upload a CSV / XLSX file of invoices
post.description:
Each row is validated and classified:

| Classification | Meaning | Stored as invoice? |
|---|---|---|
| `MATCHED` | Agrees with its PO; PO balance is reduced | yes |
| `MISMATCHED` | Valid, but wrong vendor for the PO / exceeds balance / PO closed | yes, for review |
| `DUPLICATE` | Same vendor + invoice number already exists or repeats in the file | no |
| `FAILED` | Missing/invalid fields, unknown or inactive vendor, unknown PO, bad dates/amounts | no |

**Columns** (header row required, any order, case-insensitive):
`invoice_number, vendor_code, po_number, invoice_date, due_date, amount`
plus optional `tax_amount` (default 0) and `total_amount` (default amount + tax).

parameters.name: force

schema.description: Process the file again even if identical content was uploaded before (ignored when an Idempotency-Key header is sent). Already-imported rows are then reported as duplicates.
schema.title: Force

parameters.description: Process the file again even if identical content was uploaded before (ignored when an Idempotency-Key header is sent). Already-imported rows are then reported as duplicates.

parameters.name: idempotency-key

schema.description: Optional client-generated key. Re-sending the same key and file returns the original result. Defaults to the file's SHA-256.
schema.title: Idempotency-Key

parameters.description: Optional client-generated key. Re-sending the same key and file returns the original result. Defaults to the file's SHA-256.

200.description: Idempotent replay of an earlier upload.

post.description:
Classifies every `PENDING` and `MISMATCHED` invoice (e.g. invoices
created through the Django CRUD API, or mismatches whose PO has since
been corrected). `MATCHED` invoices reduce their PO's remaining balance.

Safe to call repeatedly: already-matched invoices are never re-processed.

Re-evaluates one invoice against its vendor and purchase order.
Returns the current result unchanged if the invoice is already `MATCHED`.

get.description:
Invoice counts and amounts per vendor, broken down by reconciliation
status. Vendors with no invoices in the period are listed with zeros.

Total, invoiced and remaining amount per purchase order, plus grand
totals across all POs matching the filters.

parameters.name: has_balance

schema.description: true = balance left, false = fully invoiced.
schema.title: Has Balance

parameters.description: true = balance left, false = fully invoiced.

totals.description: Totals across every PO matching the filters (not just this page).

include_failed.title: Include Failed
include_failed.description: Also retry FAILED invoices (PENDING and MISMATCHED are always included).

ReconciliationStatus.title: ReconciliationStatus
ReconciliationStatus.description:
Status of a persisted invoice.

There is no DUPLICATE here on purpose: a duplicate (same vendor + invoice
number) is rejected before it is stored, so it only ever appears as the
classification of an upload row.

RecordClassification.title: RecordClassification
RecordClassification.description: Outcome of the reconciliation rules / of one row of a bulk upload.

UploadBatchOut.title: UploadBatchOut
UploadBatchOut.description:
Processing summary of one upload.

success_count + failure_count + duplicate_count == total_records.
success = rows imported as invoices (matched_count + mismatched_count).

idempotent_replay.title: Idempotent Replay
idempotent_replay.description: True when this upload was already processed and the stored result is being returned; nothing was processed again.

valid_records.title: Valid Records
valid_records.description: Rows imported as invoices (MATCHED or MISMATCHED).

invalid_records.title: Invalid Records
invalid_records.description: Rows rejected (FAILED or DUPLICATE), with reasons.
